_doc: Walk Studio DYNAMIC BANDED PRICING — single source of truth for per-video pricing.
All money is in integer CENTS (USD), matching producer.py's convention (1 Higgsfield
credit ~= 1 cent; Seedance ~22-27cr/clip, gpt_image_2 ~7cr, edge-tts/Remotion/walk-agent free).
PRICING MODEL (decided with Dennis): the customer PRICE is DYNAMIC, derived from the
STORYBOARD SIGNALS (scene count, cinematic scene count, total duration) PLUS a token-cost
COGS line, then CLAMPED to a per-tier PRICE BAND. The price is no longer a flat tier number —
it scales with how much the agent actually produced, but never escapes the tier's band.
standard = 500 + 50*max(0,scenes-3) + 50*ceil(max(0,dur-20)/10) + token_cost, clamp [500,1000]
premium  = 1500 + 150*cinematic + 100*ceil(max(0,dur-20)/10) + vo_surcharge + token_cost, clamp [1500,2500]
price_for_plan(...) still exists for existing callers and returns the SAME quote shape; the
new storyboard-aware entry threads the signals from the producer est into the price.
Consumed ONLY when env WS_PREMIUM_MENU=1. pricing.py is the loader/API; do not hand-edit
consumers against this file directly. plan_cogs_cents = the variable-spend ceiling the budget
gate locks (what the agent SPENDS, now INCLUDING the planner token COGS); price_cents = what the
customer PAYS. The band FLOORS always exceed COGS, so margin = (price - cogs) / price stays > 0.
ONE customer choice, made UPFRONT: a QUALITY dimension (standard | premium). It changes WHAT THE
AGENT PRODUCES (and therefore the COGS the budget gate locks) AND which price band/formula applies:
- standard ($5-$10 band): Remotion designed motion-graphics + edge-tts voiceover. NO Higgsfield,
NO ElevenLabs. Media COGS ~free; only the planner token COGS lands.
- premium ($15-$25 band): adds cinematic AI footage (Higgsfield) + a natural ElevenLabs voiceover.
Those land in COGS (the budget-gate ceiling); the price scales with cinematic count + duration + VO.
`cogs_floor_cents` below is a small minimum premium media COGS, on the COGS/budget side only.
TOKEN COST -> COGS: token_rate_cents_per_1k below prices the PLANNER (brain) tokens used to plan the
storyboard, per brain. cents per 1k tokens, derived from the per-1M-token OpenRouter rates in brain.py
(super-free 0/0; super-paid 0.09/0.45 per Mtok = 0.009/0.045 per 1k; ultra-paid 0.50/2.20 per Mtok =
0.05/0.22 per 1k). Planner tokens are ESTIMATED from VO script length + scene count. The token COGS is
FOLDED into total COGS for BOTH the budget gate and the price floor. walkthrough_steps is a future hook:
Walk-Agent walkthroughs will cost ~15 ultra-proposer + ~30 nano-judge Nemotron calls per run — defaults
to 0 today (no token cost) until that path ships.
LEGACY (retained for back-compat, NOT driving the customer price):
tier_price_cents (standard 999 / premium 1999) is the OLD flat fixed-tier price — kept as a fallback
if price_band_cents is absent for a tier. markup / price_floor_cents / round_to_cents were the even
older cost-plus knobs; base_price_for_cogs still reads them so any stale caller keeps working.

token_rate_cents_per_1k._doc: cents per 1000 tokens, per brain (input=prompt, output=completion). Derived from brain.py per-1M-token rates / 1000. super-free is $0; super-paid 0.009/0.045; ultra-paid 0.05/0.22.

standard.label: Standard
standard._doc: Remotion designed motion-graphics + edge-tts voiceover. No Higgsfield, no ElevenLabs — media COGS ~free (only planner token COGS lands). Customer price is dynamic within the band below.
standard.blurb: Designed motion graphics + a clean synthetic voice. Fast and free to make.

premium.label: Premium
premium._doc: Cinematic AI footage (Higgsfield) + a natural ElevenLabs voiceover. Those land in COGS (the budget-gate ceiling); the customer price scales within the band below with cinematic count + duration + VO. cogs_floor_cents (100c=$1) only affects the COGS/budget side, not the customer price.
premium.blurb: Cinematic AI footage (Higgsfield) + a natural studio voice (ElevenLabs). Richer and more lifelike.
